description: The Browns struggle to become a family again in Everwood as Andy opens a free clinic, Ephram grows close to Amy Abbott and the possibility of treating her comatose boyfriend Colin forces Andy into a decision that will affect the whole town.

s01e01.description: After his wife’s death, renowned surgeon Andy Brown moves Ephram and Delia from Manhattan to Everwood, hoping a radical change will help rebuild their fractured family.

s01e02.description: Ephram resents Andy for once again putting medicine ahead of family, while he begins to suspect Amy’s interest in him is tied to her hopes for Colin.

s01e03.description: Delia struggles to make a friend, Ephram is excluded by his classmates, and Andy angers conservative townspeople by defending Nina’s decision to become a surrogate.

s01e04.description: A local STD outbreak forces Everwood’s teenagers to confront the limits of their ideas about safe sex, while Edna fights to preserve a beloved town landmark.

s01e05.description: Ephram becomes determined to return a lost deer to the wilderness, while Delia searches for reassurance that her mother is safe somewhere after death.

s01e06.description: A visiting psychologist becomes popular with the town and privately helps Andy face the decision of whether to operate on Colin, while Delia learns a friend’s secret.

s01e07.description: Andy performs the dangerous surgery that could awaken Colin as Amy and Bright revisit the accident that left him comatose and Ephram supports Amy through the wait.

s01e08.description: Andy’s wedding anniversary revives his grief as he tries to help two troubled marriages, while Ephram and Amy kiss and Colin finally awakens from his coma.

s01e09.description: Ephram and Delia’s grandparents arrive with strong opinions about Andy’s parenting and encourage Ephram’s desire to leave Everwood and return to New York.

s01e10.description: A snowstorm traps guests at Edna’s birthday celebration and forces an emergency appendectomy, while Nina urges Andy to speak honestly with Ephram about their relationship.

s01e11.description: Delia tries to recreate her mother’s Thanksgiving traditions as Andy handles a difficult kidney-donor case and Harold is forced to reconsider what matters to him.

s01e12.description: Colin returns home without sharing Amy’s memories of their relationship, while a medical-marijuana controversy forces the town to take sides over treatment and personal choice.

s01e13.description: Ephram unexpectedly gains social status when Colin befriends him, while Edna’s forceful direction of the school production creates another kind of chaos around town.

s01e14.description: Basketball season puts Bright back in his element, but Colin struggles with the pressure of returning to a life and reputation he can barely remember.

s01e15.description: A church ski trip reshuffles the teenagers’ relationships as Amy reconnects with Colin, Bright pursues romance and Ephram grows closer to Laynie.

s01e16.description: Andy and Dr. Trott grow closer while Ephram bonds with Laynie and the Abbott family enters couples therapy, leaving several relationships newly exposed.

s01e17.description: Andy and Harold investigate an elderly man’s confession to a long-unsolved murder, while Laynie tells Ephram that Colin had planned to break up with Amy before the accident.

s01e18.description: On the anniversary of Julia’s death, Ephram confronts painful suspicions about Andy while new symptoms raise fears that Colin’s recovery may be failing.

s01e19.description: A New York journalist arrives to profile Colin’s seemingly miraculous recovery, forcing Andy and the town to confront how much of that miracle may be wishful thinking.

s01e20.description: A strange sighting sparks a UFO frenzy in Everwood while Ephram prepares for a piano recital and discovers an uncomfortable truth about his teacher and another student.

s01e21.description: A frightened pregnant teenager divides the town and forces Andy and Harold to confront their own convictions about medicine, responsibility and personal choice.

s01e22.description: Ephram’s near-fatal boating accident gives Andy new perspective on Colin’s worsening condition, while Nina finally learns the truth about her absent husband.

s01e23.description: Andy seeks advice from his old mentor before Colin’s high-risk operation, while Colin spends the remaining hours comforting the people waiting anxiously for the outcome.
